headline: Meta tests an AI pendant; Descendants inches up
body: A light day. Reuters reported Meta is testing an AI pendant and work wearables, a step toward always-on AI on the body that adds to Human-AI Merging and lifts Descendants. China's Wang Yi called for international AI regulation at the UN, and NIST broadened its AI consortium from safety toward innovation. Horizon Balance is 0.5, up 0.02.
movers_note: Descendants +0.2, mostly from Meta's AI wearables (+0.19); Libertarian Utopia +0.1 from the same story (+0.10).
